articles.title: Prices Are Rising Faster Than Expected
articles.summary: A new report shows US prices are 3.7 percent higher than last year, rising faster than experts expected.

articles.title: Ukraine's Military Has Less Access to Starlink
articles.summary: Ukraine's military has lost some access to Starlink, and Elon Musk says any limits came from the U.S. government.

articles.title: Social Security Payments Will Go Up 3.6 Percent
articles.summary: Social Security payments will rise 3.6 percent in 2027 to help people keep up with rising prices.
